name: Send Checks
author: Bulwark Mail Community
description: Checks a message before it is sent: IBANs, payment card numbers, keywords and your own patterns in the subject, text and text attachments, and attachment types and sizes. Each rule warns or blocks, optionally only when the message goes outside the organisation.

ibanAction.label: IBANs
ibanAction.description: Bank account numbers (IBAN) that pass the check-digit test. Warn asks the user to confirm; Block stops the send.

ibanExternalOnly.label: IBANs: only outside the organisation
ibanExternalOnly.description: Check IBANs only when a recipient is outside the organisation (the domains of Organisation > Security > External mail and the sender's own domains).

cardAction.label: Payment card numbers
cardAction.description: 13 to 19 digit card numbers that pass the Luhn check. The warning shows only the last four digits.

cardExternalOnly.label: Card numbers: only outside the organisation
cardExternalOnly.description: Check card numbers only when a recipient is outside the organisation.

keywords.label: Keywords
keywords.description: One word or phrase per line, matched in any case. A keyword that starts and ends with a letter or digit matches whole words only. Lines starting with "# " (hash and space) or "//" are comments, so "#confidential" works as a keyword. Empty: no keyword check.

patterns.label: Patterns
patterns.description: One regular expression per line, as Name: pattern or Name: /pattern/flags (flags i, m, s, u; without flags the match ignores case). Comment lines start with "# " or "//". At most 50 lines of 200 characters. Patterns run apart from the page and are stopped after 250 ms per message. A line with a repeat inside a repeated group such as (a+)+, repeated alternatives such as (a|b)+, repeats next to each other that match the same characters such as \s*\s*, or back references can't run: it counts as a check that couldn't finish, so with Block nothing is sent until you fix it.

blockedTypes.label: Blocked file types
blockedTypes.description: Extensions and MIME types, separated by commas or spaces, e.g. exe, bat, js, application/x-msdownload. A blocked program extension such as exe also catches a renamed program by its content.
blockedTypes.placeholder: exe, bat, cmd, com, scr, js, vbs, ps1, msi

allowedTypes.label: Allowed file types
allowedTypes.description: When set, only these extensions or MIME types may be attached (e.g. pdf, docx, xlsx, image/*). Images pasted into the text are not affected. Empty: every type not blocked above.

maxSizeMb.label: Largest attachment (MB)
maxSizeMb.description: Per file, including images pasted into the text. 0: no limit.

attachmentAction.label: Attachments: action
attachmentAction.description: Block refuses a file as soon as it is attached (unless the rule counts only outside the organisation) and again at Send.

nb.warn.title: Sjekk før sending
nb.warn.message:

nl.warn.message:

nl.block.title: Dit bericht kan niet verstuurd worden
nl.outside.note: Sommige hiervan tellen alleen mee omdat het bericht buiten je organisatie gaat.
nl.unchecked.title: Dit bericht kon niet gecontroleerd worden

pl.warn.title: Sprawdź przed wysłaniem
pl.warn.message:

pl.block.title: Tej wiadomości nie można wysłać
pl.outside.note: Niektóre z nich liczą się tylko dlatego, że wiadomość wychodzi poza Twoją organizację.

pl.upload.unreadable: Nie udało się sprawdzić pliku {name}, więc nie można go dołączyć. Spróbuj ponownie za chwilę.

pt.outside.note: Alguns destes só contam porque a mensagem sai da sua organização.

ru.unchecked.title: Не удалось проверить это письмо
